usage: These audio exports are embedded in pi-workspace as application notification cues. They must not be redistributed as standalone sounds or a sound pack.

renderer.method: Executed the original renderer from const TAU through renderSound, excluding only the React import and unused interactive playback/hook code; executed the original encodeWav function without its module export keyword. No synthesis or audio processing logic was rewritten.
renderer.tuneMeaning: All original defaults: pitch 0, tone 0, length 1, space 0, punch 0, volume 0 dB, variation 0, no additional effects. Recipe-defined synthesis, reverb, trimming, fades and loudness normalization are retained.
renderer.postProcessing: Converted the original 24-bit PCM exports to standard 16-bit little-endian PCM WAV for Windows SoundPlayer compatibility, preserving sample rate, channels and frame count. Each signed 24-bit sample is multiplied by assetGain / 256, rounded to nearest (ties to even), then clamped to [-32768, 32767]; no dither. Pluck assetGain=1, Hint assetGain=0.6. Playback uses unity gain on every platform.

sounds.description: A soft string pluck for picking from a list.
A neutral, airy tone for tips and info.

playback: Bundled files are 48 kHz stereo 16-bit PCM WAV. macOS uses afplay; Windows uses Windows PowerShell calling synchronous WinMM PlaySoundW with SND_FILENAME and SND_NODEFAULT, checking the Boolean result; Linux tries pw-play, paplay, then aplay, advancing only when an executable is missing. All players use unity gain; Hint attenuation is baked into its asset.
